title: FixOutput
description: One auto-fix attempt for a single confirmed + reachable finding. The agent edits code inside an isolated git worktree; the harness derives the patch from `git diff`, so this output is metadata describing the change, not the diff itself.

fixed.description: True if you edited the code to remediate the bug. False if you could not produce a safe fix (explain in `caveats`).

summary.description: One line: what the patch does.

root_cause.description: Why the bug exists — the property the fix restores.

fix_approach.description: How the fix works and why it is minimal and behavior-preserving.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths you edited (informational; the real diff is captured from git).

regression_test.description: A test you added that fails on the vulnerable code and passes after the fix.

path.description: Repo-relative path of the test file you created/extended.

framework.description: Test framework / runner (e.g. bun:test, pytest, go test).

run_command.description: Command a maintainer runs to execute just this test.

proves.description: How the test demonstrates the vulnerability is closed.

caveats.description: Risks, assumptions, or why no fix was produced.
